title_zh: 需求还在，买家在观望：八大方向的需求×供给对照
title_en: Demand Persists, Buyers Hesitate: A Demand x Supply Map in Eight Directions
desc_zh: ① 家庭维修自诊是全年最大真空，供给全是玩具规模；② 记账类工具几乎全哑火，单环节幸存者活得很好；③ AI agent 供给爆炸遇上买方疲劳——PH 票数是同行鼓掌，Reddit 评论区才是用户表情。
desc_en: 1) home-repair self-diagnosis is the year's biggest vacuum; 2) bookkeeping tools flopped while single-workflow survivors thrive; 3) AI-agent supply explosion meets buyer fatigue - PH votes are peer applause, Reddit comments are the user's face.
